species: Here, we report that Fusarium graminearum (Fg), a destructive fungal pathogen of cereal crops, is challenged by host-derived high-iron stress.
sample_source: The Fg wild-type strain PH-1 (NRRL 31084) was used as a parental strain throughout this study.
